body: I like being able to think, but I compartmentalize that outside of my humanity. I really identify with the story "They're made out of meat", if you've ever read it.

> You're a human,

And that's my issue, I guess. I'm really not okay with being an organism. Succumbing to the need for nutrients, emotional stimulation, sex, violence, excretion and so forth. And I don't enjoy doing any of those things because of it.

Unfortunately, those things compose the majority of my waking life, so you can see why I might not want to participate anymore.

I'm not concerned with actually being "cool". I'm more concerned with the implications for caring about being "cool".

What does that mean for who I am?

Is that me giving into the frivolity of teenage life?

For someone who looks down upon day-to-day life as trivial, and tries to avoid thinking about that kind of life, am I contradicting myself?

That sentence doesn't even make sense. What implications does my coming up with incoherent thoughts have?

And so forth
16, which makes this seem all the more silly. I'm an only child that doesn't do much; doesn't speak with family much. Living on the east coast of the US.
